basis.bound: Sum of Bound layers in the reinsurance sheet
basis.offered: Sum of Offered layers in the reinsurance sheet
basis.available: AUM minus bound, offered and the liquidity layer
basis.liquidityLayer: 15% of AUM, the policy share shown on the official Transparency page (not a measured balance)
basis.aum: Live TVL from the OnRe core API

data.note: The sum check is shown, not assumed: available capital is AUM minus the other three parts, so a mismatch appears only if a part is added independently.
